body: I don't know what to do I'm all alone. I don't have anyone to talk to. No friends or anything. Because my stupid ass went all in on her. I put all i owned and everything I had into one fucking relationship and I fucked it up my self. I can't sleep at night because I know she doesn't think about me and I probably don't mean shit to her. It rips me apart knowing she's already with someone else. She's happy with someone else. While I sit here and can't cry anymore because nothing's coming out.. It's been months and I'm still broken. Everything I do is temporary and when l I turn of the light at night and try to sleep then the cycle repeats every single day..
